product.name: LocalCloud
product.productionBoundary: LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

runtimeImage.limitation: The repository agrees across the reviewed runtime launcher and CLI, but the mutable latest tag has no qualified assembled-image digest.

operator.manualDockerCommand:
docker volume create localcloud-data

docker run -d --name localcloud \
  -p 127.0.0.1:24080-24092:24080-24092 \
  -m 4g \
  -v localcloud-data:/var/lib/localcloud \
  jaysen2apache/localcloud:latest

supportedHosts: Linux with glibc 2.35+ on arm64 or amd64
cli.integrity: The installer verifies SHA-256 checksums, exact archive members, and the executable semantic version. Release automation separately publishes Sigstore bundles; install.sh does not verify them.
cli.releaseBoundary: CLI 0.1.2 behavior is documented from the current sibling source snapshot. Source digests identify working-tree changes not captured by cliRevision. Use localcloud --version to confirm the installed release.

acceptedEnvelopes.description: Top-level service keys for the default project.
A services mapping for one selected project.
A projects mapping whose entries each contain service seed data.

limitations: Firestore has no enabled seed registrar.
LOCALCLOUD_TERRAFORM_MODE=true skips seeding.
Volatile mode is bounded to registered volatile seed targets; verify the selected service before relying on restart behavior.

terraform.credentialRequirement: A syntactically valid fake service-account JSON file; /dev/null is not sufficient for provider v7.

networkModes.description: Use generated custom endpoints for resources whose provider clients honor them.
requirements: eval generated values from /env?format=terraform or localcloud env --format terraform

networkModes.description: Use LocalCloud DNS/HTTP/HTTPS routing for clients that ignore custom endpoints.

limitations: Some resources require transparent DNS/HTTPS routing and a trusted LocalCloud certificate.
BigQuery ignores its custom endpoint and requires transparent routing.
Resource support is bounded to maintained qualification evidence.
A service-error/crash event method exists but no main-source caller was found.
Disabling telemetry emits a telemetry_disabled event before suppression.

outboundBehaviors.control: CLI/runtime configuration; verify the release used

limitations: Core operation can continue offline after the image is present only when outbound features are disabled or unused; do not describe the product as categorically offline.

licensing.permittedUse: Community Use by individual developers acting personally, students acting personally or academically, and legally organized nonprofit organizations supporting their nonprofit mission.

technicalEnforcement.developmentBuild: Enforcement may be disabled and technical Pro access granted.
technicalEnforcement.enforcedBuild: LOCALCLOUD_API_KEY is required; validation failure terminates startup.
technicalEnforcement.serviceTiers: services.yaml minTier controls technical service availability but does not grant legal permission.

limitations: Technical tier availability does not grant legal permission.
Contacting LocalCloud does not grant commercial rights; a separate written Commercial License must take effect.
Conflicting Apache-2.0 package or OCI metadata does not override the governing root LICENSE.

services.name: Bigtable

persistence.restartBehavior: LocalCloud Docker is intended to retain PostgreSQL-backed service data while the mounted /var/lib/localcloud volume is retained
recoveryLimitations: The machine-local cached artifact can use PostgreSQL or SQLite, but the LocalCloud Docker product is configured for PostgreSQL.
Dependency identity, restart recovery, and the assembled LocalCloud image remain release-unverified.

limitations: [prod_only] Single-node emulator by design; clusters, multi-region, replication require Google infrastructure.
GoogleSQL queries (ExecuteQuery/PrepareQuery) not supported — data-plane uses HBase-style API only.
Change streams, app profiles, and logical views are not implemented in the emulator.
Session protocol (OpenTable/OpenAuthorizedView/OpenMaterializedView) not implemented — not needed for correctness.

assembledDefault.limitation: Default enablement follows the current runtime catalog and remains subject to license-tier gates.

operations.label: IAM policy management

services.name: Spanner

persistence.backingStore: LevelDB rows plus JSON metadata at /var/lib/localcloud/spanner-data
persistence.restartBehavior: Ordinary container stop/start retains state; a mounted /var/lib/localcloud volume is required to retain state across container removal or replacement
recoveryLimitations: Rows use LevelDB and metadata uses JSON files.
Known corruption/recovery risk; internal safety snapshots are not Cloud Spanner Backup API.

limitations: Pinned extended Spanner emulator image; the exact image and immutable digest come from `SPANNER_EMULATOR_IMAGE` in the root Dockerfile.

Change-stream support matrix — native gRPC/REST ExecuteStreamingSql supported; official SDK clients through SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST supported; LocalCloud SQL Editor through managed run APIs or cancellable /query/stream NDJSON supported; gcloud spanner databases execute-sql unsupported for change streams because it uses unary ExecuteSql.

assembledDefault.limitation: Default enablement follows the current runtime catalog and remains subject to license-tier gates.

operations.label: Native SQL, read, and streaming read
limitations: Change-stream reads use native ExecuteStreamingSql. Unary ExecuteSql intentionally retains the emulator's rejection of change-stream queries.

operations.label: Sessions, transactions, and batch DML

operations.label: Partition query/read and batch write
limitations: Existing native partition and batch-write behavior remains authoritative.

services.name: BigQuery

persistence.restartBehavior: Survives restart with the LocalCloud volume
recoveryLimitations: Assembled dependency identity remains release-unverified.

limitations: DuckDB type coercion is permissive where BigQuery is strict — queries accepted locally may error in production.
Division by zero returns Inf/NaN instead of error; integer division returns int instead of FLOAT64.
GROUP BY ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS not supported.
SEMI/ANTI JOIN syntax not supported (rely on EXISTS/NOT EXISTS transpile).
BQML (CREATE MODEL, ML.PREDICT, ML.EVALUATE, etc.) returns clear error.
AEAD encryption functions and KLL quantile functions not implemented.
GEOGRAPHY functions use haversine approximation, not true WGS84 geodesic.
BIGNUMERIC truncated to DECIMAL(38,9); FARM_FINGERPRINT requires pyfarmhash for correct values.
Time travel (FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF), continuous queries, graph queries, search/vector indexes not supported.
External object tables (OBJ.* functions) not supported.

assembledDefault.limitation: Default enablement follows the current runtime catalog and remains subject to license-tier gates.

operations.label: SELECT, JOIN, window functions, CTEs, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, MERGE
limitations:
DuckDB-backed via SQLGlot transpiler. ~96% BigQuery SQL coverage, 175+ functions.
958 tests passing. Key gaps: GROUP BY ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS, SEMI/ANTI JOIN,
BQML (clear error), AEAD encryption, KLL quantiles, graph queries, continuous queries.
⚠ Type coercion risk: DuckDB is permissive where BigQuery is strict — queries that
work locally may error in production. Division by zero returns Inf instead of error.
GEOGRAPHY: 12 ST_* functions with haversine approximation (not true geodesic).

operations.label: DECLARE, SET, IF/WHILE/LOOP, BEGIN/EXCEPTION, CALL, EXECUTE IMMEDIATE
limitations: Full scripting interpreter with variable scoping, BREAK/CONTINUE, RAISE, transactions.

operations.label: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW, auto-refresh
limitations: Supported in emulator with PARTITION BY, CLUSTER BY, OPTIONS.

operations.label: query Parquet/CSV/JSON files (local + GCS)
limitations: CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE with format/uris options. Object tables not supported.

operations.label: gRPC Storage Read/Write API (AVRO + Arrow)
limitations: gRPC endpoint on port 24088. ReadRows with streaming support.

operations.label: INFORMATION_SCHEMA views
limitations: 11 views: COLUMNS, TABLES, SCHEMATA, PARTITIONS, VIEWS, ROUTINES, TABLE_OPTIONS, TABLE_STORAGE, JOBS_BY_*, COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS.
